articles.title: Why Your Ticketing System Should Be Working Harder for Your FEC
articles.summary: Industry veteran Andy Povey argues that attraction operators are underutilizing their ticketing and technology platforms, settling for tools that simply sell tickets rather than generate actionable data and deepen guest relationships. Povey calls on operators to demand more from technology suppliers, including integrated data insights that support smarter decisions without sacrificing the human connection. For FEC operators, this is a timely challenge to audit whether their current platforms are truly driving revenue and retention.

articles.title: Game Volt Debuts RFID-Connected Carnival Games Platform at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026
articles.summary: Game Volt will premiere Carnival Games: The Supercharged Funfair at IAAPA Expo Europe, blending traditional midway-style games with RFID connectivity, venue-wide leaderboards, and team competition mechanics. The platform is designed to turn standalone game cabinets into a socially connected experience that increases engagement and dwell time. FEC operators looking to modernize their arcade or redemption floors should pay close attention to this integrated competitive format.

articles.title: Attraktion! to Supply Two New FlyXD Flying Theater Systems in Europe for 2027
articles.summary: Attraktion! has confirmed contracts for two new FlyXD flying theater installations in Europe scheduled to open in 2027, and will showcase a new LED-equipped unit at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026. Flying theaters remain one of the most popular large-format immersive attractions for FECs and entertainment destinations. The new LED solution could reduce operational costs and improve content flexibility for venue operators.

articles.title: DOF Robotics Unveils SphereFly Compact Immersive Attraction at IAAPA Expo Europe
articles.summary: DOF Robotics will debut SphereFly, a new immersive simulation attraction engineered for small spaces traditionally unsuitable for large-format experiences, at IAAPA Expo Europe 2026. Guests sit in a suspended arrangement facing a curved screen with synchronized motion, making it an appealing option for FECs with limited square footage. The company will also preview a new Transformers IP collaboration and launch its NeoCappadocia flagship project.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 to Feature Largest Education Program in Event History
articles.summary: IAAPA Expo Europe 2026 will offer more than 70 educational sessions with over 180 speakers, the biggest program in the event's history. For FEC operators and suppliers attending the London expo, the expanded programming represents a significant opportunity to gain operational insights and industry intelligence. Topics are expected to span technology, guest experience, design, and business strategy.

articles.title: IAAPA Expo 2026 Signature Sessions: Speakers and Details Announced
articles.summary: IAAPA has revealed details and speakers for this year's Expo signature sessions, including the Legends Panel, Leadership Breakfast, and Lunch and Learn events. These high-profile sessions attract senior operators, investors, and suppliers and set the tone for industry priorities heading into the next year. FEC executives attending the expo should plan their schedules around these anchor events.

articles.title: Intercard's Impulse Plus Reader Earns Honorable Mention at 2026 Golden Ticket Awards
articles.summary: Intercard's Impulse Plus cashless reader received an honorable mention in the best innovation category at the 2026 Golden Ticket Awards, as voted on by more than 500 industry professionals. The recognition highlights continued advancement in cashless payment and access technology that is central to modern FEC operations. Intercard remains one of the dominant players in the arcade and FEC debit card reader segment.

articles.title: Launch Entertainment Expanding to Denton, Texas with Trampolines, Arcade, and Duckpin Bowling
articles.summary: Launch Entertainment is set to open a new location at Golden Triangle Mall in Denton, Texas, featuring trampolines, an arcade, and duckpin bowling in a former anchor retail space. The opening is part of Launch's ongoing national expansion and illustrates the continued trend of FECs filling vacated mall retail footprints. Operators should note the duckpin bowling component as a differentiating attraction gaining traction in the market.

articles.title: Texas' Largest Family Entertainment Center Set to Open in Houston in 2026
articles.summary: A new family entertainment center billing itself as Texas' biggest is slated to open in Houston in 2026, drawing regional attention and competitive interest. Large-format FEC openings in major metro markets like Houston signal growing investor confidence in the sector. Existing operators in the region should monitor the development as it may reshape consumer expectations for scale and attraction variety.

articles.title: iP2 and DreamWorks Animation Partner to Develop Scalable Urban Family Entertainment Model
articles.summary: iP2 has teamed with DreamWorks Animation to create a scalable family entertainment concept for urban markets, leveraging DreamWorks' IP portfolio to drive brand recognition and guest appeal. The partnership signals growing interest from major entertainment brands in the FEC and location-based entertainment space. Operators and developers watching the IP-driven FEC trend should follow this model closely as it could set new benchmarks for licensed urban entertainment venues.

articles.title: Chuck E. Cheese Adventure World Makes International Debut in Mexico
articles.summary: Chuck E. Cheese has launched its Adventure World format internationally for the first time with a new location in Mexico, marking a significant milestone in the brand's global expansion strategy. The Adventure World concept represents a larger, more experiential evolution of the traditional Chuck E. Cheese format. FEC operators and franchisors should watch how this international rollout performs as a signal of global appetite for the upgraded family entertainment model.

articles.title: LaPorte, Indiana FEC to Feature Bowling, Mini-Golf, Arcade and More
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center is coming to LaPorte, Indiana with a multi-attraction lineup including bowling, mini-golf, and arcade games. The development reflects the continued expansion of multi-concept FECs into mid-size markets across the Midwest. Suppliers and developers targeting secondary markets should note the growing demand outside major metro areas.

articles.title: New Indoor FEC Opens in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee Over Labor Day Weekend
articles.summary: A new indoor family entertainment center opened in Mt. Juliet, Tennessee just in time for the Labor Day weekend, bringing new entertainment options to the rapidly growing Nashville suburb. The opening highlights the strong demand for family entertainment in high-growth residential communities. FEC developers and site selectors should take note of suburban Nashville as a target market.

articles.title: Family Entertainment Center Coming to Former Big Lots Space in Wenatchee, Washington
articles.summary: A family entertainment center is planned for a former Big Lots retail location in Wenatchee, Washington, continuing the trend of FEC operators repurposing vacant big-box retail spaces. The adaptive reuse model offers cost efficiencies and built-in parking that make former anchor retail locations attractive for entertainment operators. This is another example of the structural shift in retail real estate benefiting the FEC industry.

articles.title: NRG Adventure Park Moves Toward Build-Out at Jacksonville's Southside Commons
articles.summary: NRG Adventure Park is advancing through the development process at the Southside Commons shopping center in Jacksonville, Florida, with build-out now progressing. The project adds to a growing list of adventure park-style FECs filling mixed-use and retail destinations in the Southeast. Suppliers and contractors active in the Florida market should monitor this project's timeline.

articles.title: First Renderings Revealed for MADCAPS Entertainment Center in Maricopa, Arizona
articles.summary: New renderings offer the first public look at MADCAPS, an upcoming entertainment center planned for Maricopa, Arizona, a fast-growing Phoenix suburb. The visuals indicate a multi-attraction concept targeting the area's expanding family demographic. FEC developers eyeing the greater Phoenix market should note the competitive landscape taking shape in surrounding communities.

articles.title: Imagicaaworld Raises ₹248 Crore by Divesting Hotel Property to Fund Core Attractions Business
articles.summary: India's largest amusement and water park operator, Imagicaaworld, has approved the sale of its 287-key Novotel Imagicaa hotel for ₹248 crore to Juniper Hotels, freeing up capital to invest in its core entertainment operations. The strategic divestiture signals a sharpened focus on attractions rather than hospitality assets and could fund significant expansion or reinvestment. Investors in the global FEC and amusement park sector should view this as a case study in portfolio rationalization.

articles.title: Immersive 2.0: How the Experiential Entertainment Genre Is Evolving
articles.summary: The immersive entertainment sector is undergoing a significant evolution, moving beyond novelty pop-up formats toward more durable, narratively rich, and technologically sophisticated experiences. This shift has direct implications for FEC operators considering immersive attractions as anchor offerings or differentiation strategies. Understanding where the genre is heading can help operators make smarter investment decisions in new attraction categories.

articles.title: Attractions Industry Missing Revenue Opportunities in Retail and Hospitality Extensions
articles.summary: A new analysis ahead of IAAPA Expo Europe argues that attraction operators are leaving significant revenue on the table by underutilizing the brands, IP, and guest loyalty they have already built, particularly in retail and hospitality touchpoints. For FEC operators, extending the guest experience through themed merchandise, food and beverage, and secondary revenue streams can meaningfully increase per-cap spending. The piece offers a strategic framework for operators looking to grow revenue without adding new major attractions.

articles.title: International Ride Training Launches European Affiliate to Expand Safety and Compliance Services
articles.summary: International Ride Training has established IRT Attractions Consulting, SLU, a new European-based affiliate headquartered in Madrid, to serve its growing client base across the continent. The expansion reflects increasing demand for professional safety training, auditing, and certification services in European attractions markets. FEC operators and theme parks with European footprints now have a dedicated regional resource for operational safety compliance.

articles.title: Attraktion! Products Installed at New Polish Adventure Park
articles.summary: Attraktion! has completed installation of several attractions from its product catalogue at a new adventure park in Poland, expanding its European presence. The installation demonstrates the growing appetite for turnkey attraction solutions in Central and Eastern European leisure markets. FEC developers and operators considering Attraktion!'s lineup should note the company's active deployment record.

articles.title: Merlin Introduces Virtual Queue App for Guests with Accessibility Needs Across UK Parks
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments is rolling out a new app-based virtual queuing system for its Ride Access Pass program across UK theme parks, beginning at Alton Towers and expanding chainwide by summer 2027. The upgrade follows significant public criticism over previous attempts to restrict access to the program for guests with autism, ADHD, and anxiety. FEC operators can learn from Merlin's experience as accessibility-focused queue management becomes an industry expectation rather than a differentiator.

articles.title: KAIQI Offers Turnkey FEC Design and Factory-Direct Installation Services
articles.summary: KAIQI is promoting its turnkey family entertainment center design service, offering bespoke space engineering and direct factory installation for new FEC builds. The solution targets operators and developers seeking a streamlined path from concept to opening without managing multiple vendors. For entrepreneurs and first-time FEC developers, turnkey providers like KAIQI represent an increasingly viable route to market.

articles.title: ProSlide Adds EMEA Technical Service Specialist with Waterpark Operations Background
articles.summary: ProSlide has brought on Arun Thangaraj to its EMEA team in a technical service support role, with Thangaraj bringing four years of waterpark operations experience at Atlantis the Palm. The hire reflects ProSlide's commitment to regional service capacity as waterpark and aquatic attraction investments grow across Europe and the Middle East. Operators in the region with ProSlide installations benefit from increased local expertise.

articles.title: Holiday World Brings Back Dinosaur-Themed Halloween Event with Drone Shows for 2027
articles.summary: Holiday World's popular Happy Halloween Weekends event is returning in 2027 with a dinosaur theme, featuring a 12-acre animatronic dino corn maze and a nightly drone show with 500 drones and fireballs. The event format demonstrates how seasonal programming can drive repeat visitation and off-peak revenue for family entertainment venues. FEC operators planning seasonal events can draw inspiration from Holiday World's investment in large-scale theatrical elements.

articles.title: Six Flags Fiesta Texas Wins 2026 Golden Ticket Award for Best New Show
articles.summary: Six Flags Fiesta Texas took home the 2026 Golden Ticket Award for Best New Show for its Monster Mash Bash Fright Fest production, marking the park's second consecutive win in the category. The recognition underscores the value of investing in high-quality live entertainment programming as a guest experience differentiator. FEC operators running seasonal or year-round live shows should benchmark against this level of production quality.

articles.title: Dubai Parks and Resorts to Open October 7, 2026 with Four Major Theme Parks
articles.summary: Dubai Parks and Resorts has set October 7, 2026 as its official opening date, launching MOTIONGATE Dubai, Real Madrid World, LEGOLAND Dubai Resort, and The World of Riverland as an integrated destination. The multi-park destination represents one of the most significant entertainment openings in the Middle East in years. Global FEC operators and investors should watch the Dubai market closely as it raises the competitive bar for family entertainment across the region.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Renews Partnership with Orlando Valkyries Volleyball Team
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has renewed its sponsorship partnership with the Orlando Valkyries for the 2027 Major League Volleyball season, extending the brand's community and sports marketing presence in Central Florida. Sports team partnerships offer FEC brands valuable local visibility and affinity marketing opportunities. This renewal is a useful model for FEC operators exploring non-traditional marketing channels.
